openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Archon Admin Plane
  version: "5.0.0"
servers:
  - url: http://archon-admin-plane-7ujkyfl36q-bq.a.run.app
paths:
  /api/admin/command:
    post:
      operationId: runArchonAdminCommand
      summary: Run a controlled Google Cloud admin command
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [command]
              properties:
                command:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - health_check
                    - capability_audit
                    - project_info
                    - iam_policy_read
                    - enabled_services_list
                    - run_services_list
                    - run_service_get
                    - run_logs_tail
                    - builds_list
                    - scheduler_jobs_list
                    - secrets_list
                    - storage_buckets_list
                    - artifact_repositories_list
                    - runtime_promote
                    - runtime_rollback
                    - shell_gcloud_readonly
                payload:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: true
                source:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Command result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: true
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer

truth_boundary: Read-only authority recovery. No IAM, API, deployment, traffic, secret-version, Apps Script, scheduler, or Cloud Run mutation is performed.
